STATUS: STUB - UNTESTED. Written from the structure of the Korea Forest Service forest type map (imsangdo); no data was fetched, no rule was run, no gate was evaluated for Korea. Class codes and the translation table must be checked against the current map legend before use.
fuel_map: Korea Forest Service forest type map (imsangdo, 1:5,000) translated to fuel groups; there is no national Scott & Burgan fuel model map

forest_type_classes.note: stand type (imjong/imsang) values as commonly published; verify before use

translation_to_fuel_groups.note: proposed mapping to the groups of firewitness/fuel/config/us.json; a first guess to be reviewed by a Korean fire-behaviour expert

crown_density_classes.note: stand crown density classes A (dense) B (medium) C (sparse); A and B -> dense_crown, C -> open_crown is an assumption

independent_layers_planned.land_cover: Ministry of Environment land cover map (토지피복도) or ESA WorldCover 2021 (global)
independent_layers_planned.canopy_cover: no NLCD equivalent: derive from WorldCover tree share and canopy height
independent_layers_planned.fire_perimeters: Korea Forest Service wildfire statistics / Sentinel-2 burned area (to be chosen)
independent_layers_planned.field_plots: National Forest Inventory (NFI) permanent plots via data.go.kr (key DATA_GO_KR_KEY in keys.env); coordinates and access terms not checked

rules: reuse family 1-3 of us.json after the translation; thresholds NOT calibrated for Korea
grade_note: In one Korean region 58 % of field plots matched no official fuel type (brief 53); this stub does not reproduce or test that figure.
